# Supreme AI–ML–NLP–Automission Quality Contract ## Continuous loop **Observe → Collect → Normalize → Analyze → Reason → Execute → Test → Verify → Audit → Learn → Improve** No stage may silently promote an inference into an observed fact. ## Multimodal → NLP The platform can accept text, speech, image/video and measurable sensor/environmental signals and translate patterns into simple language. Outputs distinguish: - **OBSERVED** — directly measured signal. - **INFERRED** — model-derived interpretation. - **HYPOTHESIS** — explanation requiring testing. - **UNRESOLVED** — insufficient evidence. For biological or non-biological systems, the default language must describe measured signals, possible interpretation, confidence and uncertainty rather than asserting subjective experience as established fact. ## Accuracy contract The system does not manufacture “100% accuracy”. Every model result carries provenance, confidence, uncertainty, pipeline version and verification state. Independent verification remains separate from automated QC. ## Agent contract **Intake → Evidence → ML/NLP → Reasoning → Production → Verification → Security → Publication → Continuity** Irreversible actions remain owner-authorized.
